axe_serious_critical.note: not measured here: the axe gate runs as its own CI job (pass/fail, not a count)

broad_except_with_no_named_reason.note: heuristic: a handler is 'accounted for' if its body mentions log/record/count/raise/warn

developer_text_on_screen.note: not measured: no automated 'no developer text on screen' check exists yet

docs_contradicting_the_code.note: not measured: needs a semantic reading of docs against code, not a line count

mypy_strict_errors.note: not measured: mypy is not installed here

one_unit_table_one_comparator_one_applic.note: not measured: needs a semantic check, not a line count (see #197/#736's own tracked list for the manual audit)

review_path_coverage_percent.note: not measured: no coverage tool runs in this CI job yet (#928)

rules.1: file and function length (no file over 800 lines, no function over 80)
rules.3: zero duplicated logic in the danger zone (one vocabulary, one parser, ...)
rules.5: no broad except that returns empty with no named, counted reason
rules.6: typed: mypy/pyright strict on the danger zone, then everything
rules.7: measured coverage: >= 90% on the review path
rules.8: one README, one SETUP, no doc contradicting the code
rules.9: frontend: one wording per concept, no component over 400 lines, axe green
